buildPieceResourceCost.verification: Observed legacy gameplay convention; exact C2S2 asset tuning table not obtained.

building.support: Terrain or already supported structures; decorative props do not support player builds. Source: https://www.fortnite.com/news/v3-0-0-patch-notes

match.objective: Last surviving player/team wins. Loot weapons/ammo/resources from floor and chests; avoid storm.

safeZone.verified: Epic default Advanced Storm Controller has 10 phases; each custom phase controls wait, resize, radius, damage and movement. Exact 12.00 playlist timings not obtained.

busAndDrop.verified: Players may jump while bus flies over island. Skydiving then glider, no normal glider redeploy after landing. No C2S2-native bus speed/drop terminal tuning tables obtained.
busAndDrop.note: Suggested implementation values must not be advertised as exact Fortnite physics. Original bus altitude/terminal speed needs native data or measured replay.

hudReference.kind: Firsthand PS4 gameplay recording screenshot, Chapter 2 Season 2
notes: Shield is blue above green health; both numerical values at right.
Quickbar has separate pickaxe plus five item slots; rarity colors on square tiles.
Active ammo count uses current / reserve to left of quickbar.
Compass is top center; squads top left; square minimap top right; storm time/alive/eliminations below it.
Build icons sit above quickbar, resource counters above build icons.
Reference has controller prompts; implement adjustable PC bindings in those positions.

lobbyReference.kind: Firsthand screenshot of native launch lobby shared by Fortnite News; account is not Epic official.
notes: Season 2 lobby uses grey metallic/concrete spy headquarters wall with central gold faction emblem.
Top tabs PLAY, BATTLE PASS, COMPETE, LOCKER, ITEM SHOP, CAREER, V-BUCKS.
Left blue translucent season/level/medal/mission panel; center player on lit blue circular platform.
Right mode panel with cyan CHANGE and bold yellow PLAY! button.
No unsupported store purchases or battle-pass progression should be suggested by decorative controls.
